scope: 9 canonical states × 5 sizes plus 9 extra states × 5 sizes
inspectionMethod: Every listed final PNG was individually opened with view_image and visually inspected; ten source sketch PNGs were also opened. Existence/hash/revision checks supplement, and do not replace, visual inspection.

priorities.P3: Recorded as residuals without blocking legibility, family identity, action visibility or assembly contact.

globalObservations: All five aspect/size variants show complete interactive action labels with no destructive overlap. At 1024×768 the battle header wraps to two rows and longer build-card names wrap.
The lowered square slab has continuous floor contact with the weapon turn units. Single, double, long piercer and upward mortar silhouettes remain distinguishable at minimum size.

Dense blue hatching on small tower art and slab edges becomes stippled at 1024×768 and 1280×720. This is a P3 material-density residual, not a P2 loss of family identity. No sampling across atlas crop boundaries is recommended.
Actual simulation wave numbers, resources, enemies, target direction and effects intentionally differ from the illustrated source. Runtime values were not replaced with source screenshot values.
These are functional visual-acceptance verdicts with explicit fidelity residuals, not claims of pixel-exact scene recreation.

findings.observation: Source25 gives the long barrel a large central illustration between the title and cost rows. The final purchase modal omits that illustration and leaves the upper half blank in all five sizes.
findings.requestedCorrection: Reuse the actual selected-part illustration in the modal's existing empty upper space; retain exact cost, balance, remaining-gold text and current confirmation flow.
findings.resolution: Fresh corrected25 images were individually reopened after root published them: actual selected head.long art now appears between the title and quote, and all price/balance/remainder/action labels remain visible without overlap at every size.

observations: Central castle, surrounding four tower placements and four functional structures are separated and readable; mountains and forest islands frame the cleared central area.
All eight build cards, prices, material selection, ink quantities, wave-start and overview actions remain visible at all five sizes.
residuals: Compared with source15, tower slabs are broad low squares with a visible unused second seat, and the single/mortar weapons read smaller relative to the castle.
The planning instruction is a lower-left rectangular callout rather than the source's central ribbon; resource bottles are represented by HUD quantities in the focused composition.
At 1024 the top HUD wraps to two rows; lower action controls use compact icons.

observations: Live aim directions, enemy health strips, hit splat and approach counts coexist with the castle and defense group without UI overlap.
Gun, double gun, piercer, mortar, barricade, slow device, repair and generator retain distinct shapes in both the battlefield and build cards.
residuals: Early-wave fixture is much sparser than source16's late-wave crowd and large boss group; values and actors are actual simulation state.
Blue slab hatching is stippled at short heights; long range/trajectory line is runtime geometry.
Enemy sprites crossing the world viewport edge can be partially outside the view; this is world framing rather than clipped UI.

observations: Right paper inspector has a complete double-weapon assembly illustration, durability/material/price/load/weapon-cycle rows, close action and three unobscured priority choices.
Mounted turn units touch the shallow slab and both barrels are separate; no detached or missing fragment is visible.
residuals: The modern inspector shows more runtime cycle data than source17's five-row design, using a visible scroll area. At 1024×768/1280×720 the lowest second-weapon range row is available through scrolling.
The source's illustrated icons/HP bar and radius highlight are replaced by textual runtime rows; controls remain readable.

observations: Centered paper modal, dimmed background, blue primary Continue button, Settings/Restart/Map actions and Esc hint are all visible in each size.
Text does not collide with the modal edge or buttons; underlay is consistently dimmed.
residuals: Current modal is wider with left-aligned title/actions and a short explanatory sentence; source18 has a smaller icon-led centered layout.
Action icons are smaller and simpler than the illustrated source.

observations: All three upgrade cards show their own title, identifying art, full modifier text and Choose action at all five sizes.
Long middle title wraps to two lines without touching the illustration; generator exception footer is completely visible.
residuals: Title and subtitle wording differ from source19 and the panel has a larger enclosing paper border.
Return-resources card uses a simple blue pencil glyph instead of the source's detailed pencil-and-shavings illustration; meaning and actual three bonuses remain clear.

observations: All five individually viewed images show a centered paper Statistics modal above a consistently dimmed victory result.

Two separate columns show all eight actual report fields: invested426, returned0, lost0, maxenemies0, damage0, built8, destroyed0 and upgrades3. At1024×768 and1280×720 the longest label is complete and does not enter the opposite column.
The full-width Return to results action is completely visible at each size; title, metrics and button maintain separate vertical bands without touching the modal border.
Visible saved-reward receipt behind the modal at larger sizes remains subordinate to the active statistics panel.
